custom_rules.text: Masair builds low-poly 3D geometry procedurally in GDScript via scripts/low_poly.gd and visual builders (motorcycle_visual.gd, traffic_car.gd, etc.). Do not refactor procedural mesh builders into .tscn scenes unless explicitly asked.
Godot 4.7, Forward Plus. Use GDScript 2 syntax (@export, await, CharacterBody3D). Prefer preload for LowPoly and other core modules that must work in headless CLI runs.
